speech: Here's how to open Terminal on a Mac, and start Claude Code in your Documents folder.
caption: Here's how to open Terminal on a Mac and start Claude Code in your Documents folder.

speech: First, press Command and Space, to open Spotlight search.
caption: First, press ⌘ Command + Space to open Spotlight search.

speech: Terminal opens in your home folder. The word before the percent sign shows the folder you're in.
caption: Terminal opens in your home folder (~). The word before the % shows the folder you're in.

speech: Type C D, space, tilde, slash, Documents, and press Return. C D means change directory.
caption: Type cd ~/Documents and press Return. cd means “change directory”.

speech: To check where you are, type P W D, and press Return. You're in Documents.
caption: To check where you are, type pwd and press Return. You're in Documents.

speech: Now type claude, and press Return. Claude Code starts, and can work with the files in this folder.
caption: Now type claude and press Return. Claude Code starts and can work with the files in this folder.

speech: That's it. Command Space, Terminal, C D to Documents, then claude. You'll need Claude Code installed first.
caption: That's it: ⌘ Space → Terminal → cd ~/Documents → claude. You'll need Claude Code installed first.
